# Independent review: common current and frozen source roles

Reviewed manifest `../manifest-v1.json` SHA-256 `577883bfe4bc36fe220e1fad45cf4cd9de63b69973740ef71c3cf7a881cf9040`, shared patch `6b41263b3ab7f4af5532841931a98279e49a9d23d452fbe688233bcbf451b8e1`, current patch `3d77c7cfbb9bce087237c73ad100ba870707e598c36d71949815b1a9e4f56638`, and frozen patch `e5fc87cb2a7f6ebc8b25e056fc9351a9a3b26dcc70aeed5737023e7d7516f13f`, against `8e9e7316806fe9266373865b0784e9917659e5e8` and the separately frozen fdcd source comparison. All patches applied strictly in an isolated small tree, yielding exactly the 13 staged files. No canonical edits, installation or remote operations.

No blocking finding in this bounded source-role successor. Independently checked all 44 exact source transformations and 131 scanned role occurrences. The 21 family module paths replay both the earlier local-to-shared import change from each actual prior-review source and the later shared-to-legacy-alias change. All named public peer import/export roles retain their scanned binding and syntax aside from source line movement. Each of the 131 prior common rows and full prior review records is retained, along with all prior independent-evidence references; new source hashes match actual current files. Byte-level preservation outside 73 current rows, 67 frozen rows and the two declared current metadata values passed. The five separately reviewed select-render rows and their proof bytes are unchanged from that reviewed proposal. The historical allowlist and current policy differ by exactly the seven enumerated records; all remaining policy data and ordering match.

The shared-class transition is substantive, not established by import-name equality. For example, an earlier family-local common stub is its own Bidi-only NgModule class; the owned shared core class is a different constructor and includes A11y and sanity behavior. The successor expressly records this change and relies separately on the root common-module qualification's bounded self-injector identity observations and negative controls. That earlier browser evidence used `--no-sandbox` and is retained as historical; no current sandbox-profile qualification, general lifecycle equivalence, full matrix or release claim is inferred. Fresh sandboxed results were not available or evaluated in this review.

Replayed the actual role-evidence evaluator: 73 current and 66 frozen selected roles resolved, no new insufficiencies; the frozen table NgModule role remains insufficient due to changed browser-probe evidence. The 46 blocked removed-use rows remain byte/record-identical and insufficient. Four proof mutation families were rejected. Source population/history was refreshed only as staged and the inherited production admission guard was not exercised. No combined admission, full G11, security, peer-floor or complete browser pass is claimed.
